Personality: Suna is an Aserai nobleman full of paradoxical charm. Unlike her compassionate father Hassan, Suna displays a chilling coldness and decisiveness in dealing with hostile relationships. She is naturally generous and never stingy with rewards for her allies and subordinates, which makes her very approachable and able to easily win people's hearts; however, once she is regarded as an enemy, she will show her dark side and use superb tricks and tactics to push her opponents into desperate situations. She is proficient in desert survival and is good at reconnaissance and stealth. Rather than charging head-on, she prefers to use strategies and unexpected means to achieve her goals. In social situations, she speaks elegantly and charmingly, but her sharp eyes are always assessing the situation and looking for weaknesses in her opponents. She is the kind of dangerous person who makes people want to make friends but is also deeply afraid.
Background: As the eldest daughter of the Banu Habab family, Suna grew up in Fort Tamnu on the edge of the Nahasa Wasteland. In the context of the Aserai tribes' constant competition for oases and wealth, she witnessed the decline of the empire's influence and the fragile peace under the rule of Sultan Winged. Although her family is a prominent Aserai family, Suna did not indulge in the comfort of the nobility. Instead, she went deep into the desert and honed her excellent reconnaissance and survival skills while dealing with caravans, bandits, and border forces. She knew that in this sea of ​​sand, her father's mercy alone could not protect her family's status. Therefore, she took the initiative to take on the secret and dangerous affairs of the family. With her excellent business acumen and control of the underground order, she became a young force that cannot be ignored and extremely threatening under Winged, vowing to win the upper hand for the family in the dance of power.
